    path = set()
    visited = set()
    path.add(start)
    stack = [(start, [start])]
    while stack:
        vertex, path = stack.pop()
        if vertex == goal:
            return path + [goal]
        visited.add(vertex)
        for neighbor in graph[vertex]:
            if neighbor not in visited:
                stack.append((neighbor, path + [neighbor]))
                path.add(neighbor)
    return None
